sloka: स्थितान् पश्यसि यान् एतान् मत्तान् इव महाद्विपान् ।न्यग्रोधान् इव गान्गेयान् सालान् हैमवतीन् इव ॥६-२८-२॥।।
transliteration: sthitān paśyasi yān etān mattān iva mahādvipān ।nyagrodhān iva gāngeyān sālān haimavatīn iva ॥6-28-2॥।।

translations.english: "O King! like a banyan tree on the island, like Sala trees on the Himalayan Mountain these people are stationed. You may see them marching. They are strong to encounter, can change form at their free will. They look like gods and Danavas in war and have the valour of gods."
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌ ! a जिन वानरों को मतबाले गजराजों, गङ्गा- तटवतां बटवृक्षो, हिमालयस्थित शालवृक्षों की तरह खड़े हुए देख रहे हें
